source: independent judge (grok, disposable worktree, no access to the verdict file)
why: Judge verdicts are otherwise written by the same agent that wrote the code. This run exists to produce dissent that self-review structurally cannot.
adjudication: UNADJUDICATED — each FAIL must be verified by hand before it is treated as real, and each one that turns out to be wrong must be recorded as wrong.

verdicts.note: FeaturesStep.tsx:51 still packs three selection outcomes (kept-some / deliberate-empty / all-stale→defaults) into one boolean OR ternary that only the surrounding tests and JSDoc decode: `return kept.length > 0 || value.selectedFeatureIds.length === 0 ? kept : defaults`. generate.ts:262 and :326-329 keep nested selection/storage ternaries in the same dense style. Elsewhere helpers are plain (job.ts slugFromPrompt/countEntities pipelines), but the Features gate path fails the 'reads at a glance' bar.

wizardInstanceKey (wizardSession.ts:11-13) is a single-use trivial wrapper: one production call at Home.tsx:169, body is only `` `wizard-${sessionId}-${startStep}` ``. The module+tests exist to freeze a string format (wizardSession.test.ts:5-17 arity/format checks) rather than a second real consumer. Prior single-use ghosts (isFeatureContinueBlocked, contentColumnStyle, createTimedAbort, auth hashPassword) are gone; this one remains.

Runtime deps stay react/react-dom/react-router-dom/zod (package.json:17-22). POST bodies use Zod via readValidatedBody (submit.ts:18-34, prds.ts:18-32, http.ts:55-78). Shell reuses design-system Page/Header/Footer/shellCss (Page.tsx:6-50, Header.tsx:6-60). Client GETs share useAbortableJsonGet rather than a new fetch stack.

functions/lib holds only env.ts+http.ts (no leftover auth scaffolding). abortableEffect.ts exports only FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS/createActiveFlag/errorMessageFromFetchCatch/isAbortError used by the live GET path. Saved.tsx and TemplateGallery.tsx are slim compositions after earlier bloat; wizard formStyle no longer carries an inline maxWidth layout cap (wizard/styles.ts:8-11). No large dead modules or commented-out production scaffolding remain for the cited ticket leftovers.

Both body-reading POSTs Zod-parse before use: submitBodySchema bounds prompt 8–10000, appType 1–64, hasAuth boolean, entities int 0–10000 (submit.ts:18-34); savePrdBodySchema enforces slug regex and title/prompt/markdown min/max (prds.ts:18-32) via readValidatedBody (http.ts:55-78). Over-limit bodies return 400 (submit.test.ts:59-86, prds.test.ts:35-60). GET /api/prd/:id rejects empty id with 400 and binds the id (prd/[id].ts:16-27).

No functions/lib/auth.ts and no TODO/always-true security guards under functions/. Endpoints fail closed on bad JSON/schema (submit.ts:33-34, prds.ts:31-32), DB errors (submit.ts:50-51, prds.ts:44-45, jobs.ts:20-21, prd/[id].ts:35-36), and missing rows (prd/[id].ts:30-31). Public write paths rely on Zod + parameterized .bind, not stubbed checks.

canForgePrd title-fragment branch (job.ts:112-115) is never reached by job.test.ts:97-140 (only appType/prompt/empty-features). generatePrd unresolved-title throw (generate.ts:140-145) has zero assertions in prd.test.ts (only unresolved-entities at :604-630). isTitleFragment is unit-tested in naming.test.ts, but that does not assert the canForgePrd or generatePrd branches that gate shipping. Feature-selection paths are now covered (wizard.test.ts:149-197; job.test.ts:134-140).

Features gate tests assert production isFeatureSelectionReady and toggleFeatureSelection (wizard.test.ts:104-141), not a test-only dual. resolveFeatureSelection tests stale-id drop, empty pick, and defaults (wizard.test.ts:149-197). savePrd mocks fetch at the boundary (savePrd.test.ts); jobs.test uses in-memory D1 for success/500; generatePrd tests assert markdown behaviour and UnresolvedPrdError on empty entities. Residual length>2 i18n checks exist but do not replace the behavioural suites.

Home.tsx:142-178 is a short state switch over ComposerChat/TemplateGallery/Wizard/PrdResult. Saved.tsx:67-84 composes SavedToolbar/Loading/Error/Empty/KpiStrip/CardList. Legal routes are thin LegalPage wrappers (About.tsx:13). Examples maps ExampleCard (Examples.tsx:65-67). TemplateGallery.tsx:140-176 and Wizard.tsx:267-328 own state and pass it into named children rather than inlining page-scale markup.

Saved/SavedPrd/PrdResult/Wizard submit all expose loading|error|empty|success (Saved.tsx:71-82, SavedPrd.tsx:120-136, PrdResult.tsx:111-120, Wizard handleSubmit :207-262). Primary forge path does not: Home.handleJobReady (Home.tsx:107-118) calls generatePrd with no try/catch after a successful POST. canForgePrd (job.ts:105-116) never gates unresolved entities, so a prompt like 'please make a thing' can pass Forge, queue a job, then throw UnresolvedPrdError (generate.ts:151-156) with no error UI on Home — not a defined fail-closed state for the core product screen.
